name: Dricus Du Plessis

tale_of_tape.source: data/derived/fighters.json (73 in height, 76 in reach); fight weight = middleweight limit 185 lb

photo_coverage_note: Commons has a single photo of him (2023, listed CC0 but of doubtful provenance), so there is no confirmed embed-ok photo. Recent appearance comes from reference-only July 2026 photos (Oklahoma City media day, face-off, fight night) and the UFC/ESPN studio set.

face.shape: Broad rectangular face with a wide, square jaw and a wide neck that runs almost straight down from the ears. Lean, with a slightly ruddy, weathered look.
face.jaw: Wide and square with well-defined angles; the boxed beard follows and emphasises it.
face.chin: Broad, moderately projecting and slightly squared in right profile (July 2026 face-off).
face.cheekbones: Moderate, fairly flat; cheeks lean but not hollow.
face.brow_ridge: Moderate to strong; brows sit low, so the eyes look narrowed.
face.forehead: Medium-high and broad, with horizontal lines; slight recession at the temples.

eyes.shape: Narrow almond, slightly hooded; he often squints slightly.
eyes.colour: Blue / blue-grey (clearly light in the studio headshot and July 2026 photos). Closest MakeHuman iris: blue.

eyebrows.shape: Straight and low, slightly arched at the outer third.

nose.width: Medium, slightly broad at the bridge
nose.bridge: Straight in profile, slightly flattened/broad from the front
nose.fight_damage: Mild broadening of the bridge; no clear deviation.

face.mouth_lips: Medium width; thin upper lip, medium-full lower lip; neutral expression with level corners.

ears.cauliflower_ear: Yes, mild: upper helix and inner upper ear thickened and lumpy on both ears (ESPN headshot, right ear in the July 2026 face-off profile, left ear in the media-day photo); milder than Merab's or Chimaev's.

face.marks_scars: Minor facial marks after fights (July 2026); no prominent permanent face scars. Body: a thin, pale horizontal line about 10 cm long runs from just beside the navel across his lower left abdomen in ESPN stance-right (looks like an old scar); in stance-left only a faint crease at navel height shows, so it is low render priority. Temporary bruises (yellow-green on the right shoulder in stance-left, a small purple mark on the abdomen in stance-right) should be ignored.

hair.style: Short textured crop: sides faded short (about 1 cm), top 4-6 cm pushed up and slightly forward into a small spiky quiff.
hair.colour_note: Medium brown with lighter, slightly golden tips in bright light; the samples are mid-tone medians and read darker than the overall impression, so colour_hex is lifted toward the highlights.
hair.hairline: Mild recession at the temples, straight across the front.

facial_hair.colour_note: Light-medium brown with ginger tones, a little redder than the head hair.
facial_hair.density: Medium-dense across chin, jaw and moustache; neat, even coverage.
facial_hair.shape: Short boxed beard about 1-1.5 cm, trimmed with a clean, fairly high cheek line and a defined neckline; follows the square jaw. Moustache connects.

tone_samples.where: cheeks (weigh-in stage light, flushed; not in average)

skin.tone_note: Average of the first four samples. Light skin that flushes red on the face and chest under exertion.
skin.freckles_marks: Light freckling/sun spots on shoulders and upper chest (ESPN stance photos, UFC 319 weigh-in).

body.build: Big, powerful middleweight: very broad shoulders, thick neck, dense muscle throughout; long arms (reach 193 cm at 185 cm).
body.body_fat_note: Defined six-pack and obliques in both ESPN stance photos and at the UFC 319 weigh-in.
body.shoulders: Very broad, with big round deltoids and a thick trapezius that slopes steeply into the neck.
body.chest: Full, wide pectorals; light chest hair.
body.arms: Long and muscular, large biceps peak when flexed (UFC 319 weigh-in), thick forearms.
body.waist: Narrow relative to the shoulders; clear V-taper.
body.posture: Upright, chest out; often stands slightly turned with arms hanging forward.
body.notable: Wide jaw plus very thick neck give a block-like head-neck-shoulder silhouette.

tattoos.description: None visible on torso, arms or legs in the ESPN stance photos and the UFC 319 weigh-in.

kit.fight_shorts_current: Green shorts (Usman fight, Jul 2026: green with red corner tape); title era: green compression-style shorts with South African flag stripes (red, blue, yellow, black, white) and a leafy pattern, Monster and crypto.com logos (ESPN stance-left).
kit.fight_shorts_previous: Plain dark-green Venum shorts with red 'DU PLESSIS' lettering (ESPN stance-right).
kit.weigh_in: Thin gold chain with a small gold pendant.

morphs_unavailable.note: assets/embed/mh-manifest.json has no ears/* targets. If added use about ears/l|r-ear-scale-incr 0.2 and ears/l|r-ear-rot-forward 0.15, with a thickened-helix normal map.
morphs_unavailable.arm_length: Reach 193 cm at 185 cm (ape index about +8 cm); if the rig allows, scale upper-arm and forearm bones up about 2-3%.

render_hints.skin_base: mh-skin-young_caucasian_male (closest tone) tinted toward #d58e79, slightly pink
render_hints.hair: short04 or short01 with a faded side, tinted #5c3d28
render_hints.beard: short boxed-beard texture or shell #613d2f with a crisp cheek line

notes: Confidence: high for build, jaw, eye colour, hair and beard (clear studio set plus several July 2026 photos). Medium for nose and lip detail. No confirmed licence-free photo: the only Commons file is listed CC0 but looks like a reposted social-media snapshot, so it is marked reference-only. Watch for: (1) blue eyes and ruddy skin, (2) square jaw with a neat boxed beard, (3) very thick neck and broad shoulders, (4) cauliflower ears are milder than Merab's or Chimaev's.

changes: The abdominal mark is clear (not faint) in ESPN stance-right and is on the lower LEFT abdomen, not the right.
